|errata_history=The original Set 0 slip is attested in the master PDF captured 6 August 2016. The slip captured 4 July 2017 changes “up to 15 cards” to “any number of Defensive Shields” and “may play a Defensive Shield” to “may play a card”. The 2018 full card repeats that changed text. The 2022 PC remaster retains those gameplay words and changes the printed margin mark from E to E1. These dates attest the copies, not necessarily their first release.
* '''Original''' ([[Knowledge And Defense (V)]]): the Set 0 master PDF captured 6 August 2016, page 6, prints “up to 15 cards” and “may play a Defensive Shield from here”. No errata mark appears.<ref name="pc-set0-2016">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Virtual Card Master Set, Set 0], Players Committee, official text as of 1 August 2016, page 6. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222234/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive], 6 August 2016.</ref>
* '''Errata — 2017 slip''' ([[Knowledge And Defense (V) (Errata)]]): the Set 0 master PDF captured 4 July 2017, page 4, prints “any number of Defensive Shields” and “may play a card from here”. It prints an “E” mark.<ref name="pc-set0-2017">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Virtual Card Master Set, Set 0], Players Committee, page 4. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704234722/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive], 4 July 2017.</ref>
* '''Errata — 2018 full card''' ([[Knowledge And Defense (V) (Errata)]]): the PC full-card image present by 8 July 2018 has the same game-text wording as the 2017 slip. It prints “E” and the bottom caption “•Knowledge And Defense”. The full-card image includes the upper title, lore and artwork, absent from the PDF cutout.<ref name="pc-knowledge-2018">Players Committee Holotable repository, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b], 8 July 2018. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261113121305/https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 Internet Archive]. Card image: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/knowledgeanddefense.gif</code>.</ref>
* '''PC Remastered — 2022''' ([[Knowledge And Defense (V) (Remastered)]]): the PC image uploaded 31 July 2022 prints “E1”, removes the uniqueness dot from the bottom caption and increases image dimensions from 350×490 to 745×1039 pixels. Its game-text wording remains “may play a card from here”.<ref name="pc-knowledge-2022">Players Committee Holotable repository, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419], 31 July 2022.
